content.short: Bemo Finance is a non-custodial liquid staking protocol on TON that issues stTON to maximize user yield.
content.description: Bemo Finance is a non-custodial liquid staking protocol designed for the TON blockchain. It allows users to stake their Toncoin and receive stTON tokens in return, which represent their share of the staking pool and its earned rewards. stTON can be used across various DeFi applications, ensuring that users' capital remains productive while they contribute to the security of the network. Bemo Finance focuses on providing a secure, transparent, and high-yield staking experience for all participants.
content.meta: Earn staking rewards while staying liquid with Bemo Finance on TON. Discover liquid staking on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
